title: M2 pilot plan for first DuckDB-to-Parquet migration window
instructions: Use the accepted M0 inventory and M1 contract-alignment artifacts plus real DuckDB OPEN_READONLY queries to choose exactly one low-risk pilot dataset/window. Default to daily_basic if still eligible. The pilot window must be a closed natural month and must not include the source table max date. Profile the chosen window read-only: row count, date range, key completeness, duplicate keys, and provenance distribution. Plan but do not write future M3+ paths: staging data/staging/formal-duckdb-migration/<dataset>/<window>/<run-id>/, clean version data/clean/<dataset>/_versions/<partition-id>/<version-id>/manifest.json, schema_version=clean-version-manifest/v1. Include future task outline for M3 rollback, M4 staged Parquet + clean manifest, M5 consistency + quality gate, and M6 switch proposal + rollback dry-run. Do not create M3+ task files. Write execution artifacts, then finish the task for Claude review.
summary: M2 pilot plan completed using accepted M0/M1 artifacts and real DuckDB OPEN_READONLY. Selected exactly one pilot: daily_basic month=2026-05, window 2026-05-01..2026-05-31, source max date 2026-06-29 excluded, row_count 75018, duplicate_key_count 0. Planned staging/clean manifest/query-entry paths under Cowork with schema_version=clean-version-manifest/v1. M3-M6 are outline only with create_now=false; no M3+ task files or data writes created.
